moves.proposal: No reported interval has validated coverage. The fake-data tests of Sec. IV H assess bias, not coverage: only event counts fluctuate, with systematic parameters fixed, so interval widths cannot be tested. A coverage test at two of their truths, declared in advance for the covariance without the run-period block, with pseudo-experiments that also draw the flux, interaction and detector uncertainties, stopped at one of its gates before any coverage pseudo-experiment ran: the uncertainties reproduced through its pseudo-experiments disagreed with the covariance blocks they draw, for reasons not established. The two-dimensional covariance has not been independently validated and gives no calibrated significance for generator comparisons; the coverage of its current statistical block and of its total covariance has not been tested, and an earlier statistical band of that result undercovered in its tails in a coverage test at fixed truth. Coverage here is pointwise, for each reported quantity separately; we make no coverage claim on independent simulated samples or simultaneously over all reported bins and projections.

moves.proposal: The data from the three run-period groups are not mutually consistent within the other uncertainties: their unfolded results, each relative to its own simulation, differ by more than their bootstrap scatter, and in the two-dimensional result one group's p∥ distribution differs from that of the earliest periods by a step of about 7% near 8 GeV/c. The cause is not known, and these data cannot establish which period is correct. The run-period blocks C_PL (two-dimensional result; 2.0% on the integrated cross section) and C_PL,5D (sixteen-cell result) include this inconsistency. They were added after the differences were seen, C_PL,5D following an audit whose stopping criterion was fixed in advance; each is built from the double ratios among the groups, with no reference period, so it contains the differences by construction and its own consistency check cannot fail. C_PL,5D has rank 2, is not corrected for the bootstrap noise it contains, and with three groups its size is poorly determined (68% interval on the ratio of its true to its estimated size, 0.73–2.56); it raises the median uncertainty by about 7.8% and that of cell R04 by 14.1%.
moves.retain: With it, each total χ2 is lower by 3.6–29.3 % of its value without it, and each shape-only χ2 by 7.4–40.4 %.
